When these vendors run sales

Launch weeks are the usual pattern: a new video model is unlimited on credit plans and 30–75% off on APIs for one to four weeks. The holiday window, about Nov 20 through Jan 8, is the long one. In 2025 Higgsfield posted several waves, Magnific used a 50% code, and Krea posted 40% off yearly plans. End dates move. They get extended, reopened, or left as "limited time." If a page does not name an end date, this site does not invent one. Black Friday 2026 stub, with 2025 dates.
